integration.title: Integrate canonical pinned taskctl
integration.intent: Use canonical taskctl to complete the consumer migration, then retire the copied task commands while preserving ADR tooling.
requirements: Own .agents, .taskctl, root taskctl launchers, AGENTS.md, README.md, .gitattributes, root/build and tooling/workflow integration, docs/tasking and copied tooling/taskctl removal. Product implementation and operator configuration are outside this task.
Preserve all ancestral task identities, contracts, lifecycle facts, and exact source evidence; migration equivalence reviews remain separate from old closures.
Retain ADR lifecycle tooling and shared dependencies.
acceptance: Published digest-pinned native taskctl performs normal reads, CAS rejection, evidenced transitions and offline cached execution before copied taskctl is removed.
Repository verify and retained ADR doctor/tests pass; exact report records removed legacy-tool tests separately from retained product tests.
After closure, only TASK.draft-mvp.038 remains ready; all 29 historical closures have source evidence without fabricated native receipts.
